notes:
New in 0.1.4.7 - one accuracy for everyone:
- The Fast and Performance simulation modes are gone: they simulated less accurate water. Everyone now runs the same water.
- A PC that cannot calculate the water in real time plays it in slow motion instead. The result is exactly the same, it just takes longer to watch. The info bar shows the speed (1.00x = real time).
- (From 0.1.4.6: 20 pixels per metre, smaller sharper pixels.)
